body: Four steps, clearly separated — so you always know where we are and what comes next.

steps.title: Goal
steps.description: Short briefing: your offer, your audience, the result the page should deliver.

steps.title: Structure
steps.description: Sections, content flow and the inquiry form tailored to your offer — you see a preview before design starts.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: I build the page — design, code and copy from one set of hands. You give feedback, I ship it.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Domain connected, tracking in place, live. Within 3–7 days, not 3–7 weeks.

title: How your landing page comes together.
